habits.list.statement: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM habits WHERE user_id = ?1 AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 20

habits.create.guard: You already track 20 habits. Archive one first.
habits.create.statement: INSERT INTO habits(user_id, name, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM habits WHERE user_id = ?1 AND archived_at IS NULL) < 20

habits.archive.guard: This habit is already archived, or it is not yours.
habits.archive.statement: UPDATE habits SET archived_at = ?3 WHERE id = ?1 AND user_id = ?2 AND archived_at IS NULL

checkins.add.statement: INSERT INTO checkins(habit_id, user_id, day, device, created_at) SELECT id, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5 FROM habits WHERE id = ?1 AND user_id = ?2 AND archived_at IS NULL AND ?3 BETWEEN date(?5 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-30 days') AND date(?5 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+1 day') ON CONFLICT(habit_id, day) DO NOTHING

checkins.remove.statement: DELETE FROM checkins WHERE habit_id = ?1 AND day = ?2 AND user_id = ?3

checkins.since.statement: SELECT habit_id, day, device FROM checkins WHERE user_id = ?1 AND day >= ?2 ORDER BY day DESC, habit_id LIMIT 1000

habits.streaks.statement: SELECT habit_id, MAX(CASE WHEN last_day >= date(?2, '-1 day') THEN run ELSE 0 END) AS current_streak, MAX(run) AS best_streak, SUM(run) AS total_days FROM (SELECT habit_id, COUNT(*) AS run, MAX(day) AS last_day FROM (SELECT habit_id, day, julianday(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY habit_id ORDER BY day) AS island FROM checkins WHERE user_id = ?1) GROUP BY habit_id, island) GROUP BY habit_id ORDER BY habit_id LIMIT 20

habits.import.guard: You already track 20 habits. Archive one first.
habits.import.statement: INSERT INTO habits(user_id, name, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM habits WHERE user_id = ?1 AND archived_at IS NULL) < 20

habits.mine.statement: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM habits WHERE user_id = ?1 AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 20

checkins.log.statement: INSERT INTO checkins(habit_id, user_id, day, device, created_at) SELECT id, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5 FROM habits WHERE id = ?1 AND user_id = ?2 AND archived_at IS NULL AND ?3 BETWEEN date(?5 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-30 days') AND date(?5 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+1 day') ON CONFLICT(habit_id, day) DO NOTHING

days.close.statement: INSERT INTO days(user_id, day, habits, done, closed_at) SELECT h.user_id, date(?1 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day'), count(*), count(c.id), ?1 FROM habits h LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.habit_id = h.id AND c.day = date(?1 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day') WHERE h.archived_at IS NULL AND h.created_at < (?1 / 86400000) * 86400000 AND ?2 IS NULL GROUP BY h.user_id ON CONFLICT(user_id, day) DO NOTHING

days.recent.statement: SELECT day, habits, done FROM days WHERE user_id = ?1 ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30
